name: android-tv-core
title: Android TV core user behavior
given: a generated local TV media fixture is pushed to the device
the app is launched through the test_local_path hook with a unique generated source name
when: the user scans the fixture source from Library
the user opens a poster, navigates Details, starts an episode, returns from Player, opens Settings, edits and deletes the current source, and visits the main Settings panels
then: Library, Details, Player, Back navigation, Settings focus, media-source editing/deletion, and Playback/CloudDrive/Scan/Metadata panels stay behaviorally stable
privacy-safe screenshots and sanitized UIAutomator XML are captured for contracted surfaces

steps.label: Library source scan and poster surface behavior
assertions: Library shows Explore, Scan, highest-heat, and generated fixture poster text; isolated mode also requires recently-added on the first screen.
The scan action indexes generated NFO-backed fixture episodes.

In isolated app data, DPAD Right/Left keeps navigation on the poster surface before opening Details; in KeepAppData mode, the generated poster is revealed without clearing existing content before activation.

steps.label: Details episode focus, playback launch, and Back navigation behavior
assertions: Poster activation opens Details with title, Play action, episode shelf, and first episode row.
DPAD Down from Details play focuses the first episode row.
Episode activation opens Player chrome with local playback controls and no failure overlay.
Back returns from Player to Details, then from Details to Library; isolated mode requires poster focus recovery and KeepAppData mode requires the generated poster to be revealable again.

steps.label: Settings media-source focus, edit, and deletion behavior
assertions: Settings exposes WebUI, media sources, playback, CloudDrive, scan, and metadata sections.
DPAD Down/Center opens the media-source panel and DPAD Right focuses a saved source card.
Opening the current generated source card shows the edit form for the same generated source name and path.
Deleting the current generated source removes only that source and proves stale app data cannot satisfy the check.

steps.label: Settings panel traversal behavior
assertions: CloudDrive settings show endpoint and RSS offline controls without exposing real credentials.
Scan settings show scan scheduling and media-library display controls.
Metadata settings show Bangumi token controls.
